modes.name: Unsupported evidence citation
modes.definition: The bounded decision cites an evidence identifier that is absent from the run evidence package.
modes.distinguishingNotes: Use this mode when a citation is invalid. Weak but valid evidence belongs to evidence-quality review.

modes.name: Provider overload exhaustion
modes.definition: The live model provider exhausts transient-error retries before returning a bounded triage decision.
modes.distinguishingNotes: Use when an upstream provider reports transient overload after the retry budget; do not use for malformed output, validation failures, or missing evidence.

modes.name: Duplicate recommendation action
modes.definition: The model places next_action in the explanatory recommendation as well as the authoritative decision.
modes.distinguishingNotes: Use when the explanation layer carries an action field; do not use for an incorrect or unsupported decision.next_action.
